name: Are there any pre-listing improvements I should avoid?

mainEntity.name: Are there any pre-listing improvements I should avoid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are improvements to approach with caution or avoid altogether. Generally, avoid highly personalized renovations that appeal only to specific tastes, as they may not attract a broad buyer pool. Also, be wary of projects that offer a low ROI, such as luxury additions not typical for your neighborhood, or attempting DIY projects beyond your skill level that could result in poor quality. A key process clarity step is to discuss all potential projects with your Kelby Contreras agent before starting, ensuring your efforts align with buyer expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid highly personalized renovations or projects with low ROI. Also, be cautious of DIY work beyond your skill level. Consult your agent before starting any significant project.
